Subject: Intro - billing contact & PO 7890 (Greentoast)

Hi Chloe,

Quick question from our AP team as we’re preparing the PO for your onboarding: who will be the canonical billing contact for invoices (email vs portal)? We currently default to portal ingestion for larger vendors but we need confirmation of the preferred delivery, and whether you require VAT documentation up front.

We’ve attached PO 7890 for reference. If portal is preferred, we’ll need the onboarding contact and any XML schema details; if email, we’ll need the from-address and an invoice sample.

Thanks — want to get this closed before our billing cut on Nov 1.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Finance Operations
Greentoast Inc.

Attachment: PO_7890_Greentoast.pdf
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, ap@greentoast.com
Date: 2026-10-26T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro - billing contact & PO 7890 (Greentoast)

Hi Marta — thanks for the PO and the heads-up. Short answers below, and a couple of asks so we can pick the cleanest path.

1) Primary channel: Redwood prefers portal ingestion for AP integrations (structured, retryable), but we support an email copy to a verified billing address for the first 30 days while portal enrollment completes.

2) Onboarding contact: can you confirm the AP onboarding person who will accept SAML/SCIM portal invites, or should we coordinate with ap@greentoast.com?

3) VAT: please attach the VAT certificate (if applicable) — we’ll store it against the billing profile. If Greentoast requires PDF invoices with VAT line items in a specific layout, note that in reply.

Proposed next step: we can kick portal onboarding (takes ~3 business days) and push the first invoice via email as a copy. If you prefer no email copies, note that in reply and we’ll hold sending until portal is live.

I’ve looped in Kimberly for portal SSO details and Ben on invoicing format.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick note from the portal side:

- Portal onboarding steps: invite AP admin (SAML), verify domain, accept terms. Once accepted we can push both PDF and UBL/UBL-XML if Greentoast wants structured payloads.
- Temporary email copy: we can set up invoice copies to ap@greentoast.com for 30 days. We prefer the portal as the source-of-truth.
- VAT handling: upload VAT cert to customer billing profile; we tag invoices with VAT id and handle reverse-charge where applicable.

Chloe — if Greentoast can confirm AP admin name and whether they need UBL, I’ll send the invite and a sample XML.

Ben — FYI on format: if they want specific line-item grouping, let’s confirm before the first invoice.

Thanks,
